title: World 3D Mesh Styling Premigration Parity
description: Restore premigration 3D mesh/material styling parity in the shared React world-3d renderer (framework/renderer/react/components/world-3d-host.tsx), used by puzzle 3D/5D, lowpoly, cad, remodel, shooting, procedural. Currently meshes are flat --panel colored with no edges, hover uses a subtle wrong token, and there is no highlighted/suggested tint. Port the premigration style-kind paint table (neutral/hovered/selected/highlighted/disabled) from puzzle/3d/react/index.tsx + infinite/world/r3f/index.tsx at git tag `premigration`: CSS-token-driven fill/edge colors, EdgesGeometry border outlines (inline geometry + GLB), drei Outlines selection halo, per-state emissive, and the premigration 5-light rig. Puzzle plugin (puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs) emits dead hardcoded hex colors that must be removed, and needs to unfold kind_highlighted from hovered into its own highlighted flag.
summary:
Restored premigration 3D mesh styling parity in the shared React world-3d renderer (used by puzzle 3D/5D, lowpoly, cad, remodel, shooting, procedural).

Ported the premigration style-kind paint table (neutral/hovered/selected/highlighted/disabled) to world-3d-host.tsx: CSS-token-driven fill/edge colors resolved via ui-styling's resolveColorHex (theme/dark-mode aware, with a cache-invalidation fix so dark-mode toggles actually repaint instead of returning stale cached hex values), per-state emissive material props, and a priority resolver (disabled > selected > highlighted > hovered > neutral).

Added edge outlines for both inline-geometry meshes (deduped EdgesGeometry per meshId) and GLB meshes (deduped via a WeakMap keyed by source BufferGeometry, since gltf.scene.clone(true) shares geometries across instances) — fixes the "edges not shown" complaint for puzzle's box/plane primitives which never populated Rust-side edge_positions.

Added a selection halo: drei Outlines for inline meshes (a direct mesh child, matching its documented usage); for GLB meshes, drei's Clone+inject proved fragile when combined with the injected edge-outline children (Outlines requires a direct mesh parent, and Clone's inject applies uniformly to every recursed node including the edge LineSegments), so GLB selection uses a backface-scaled duplicate mesh instead — visually equivalent, robust under <primitive>.

Restructured GlbInstanceMesh so the GLB clone (and its edge/halo children) is only rebuilt when the mesh URL/shadow settings change, not on every hover/select — style changes now update materials in place via a separate effect.

Upgraded the lighting rig to the premigration 5-light setup (ambient 1.15 + hemisphere + 3 directionals) when no sun-enabled environment is present.

Puzzle plugin (puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs): removed the dead hardcoded-hex "color" field from both puzzle3d and puzzle5d world_instances_json emitters (the host never read it), and unfolded puzzle3d's kind_highlighted (catalog-kind hover) from being folded into "hovered" into its own "highlighted" flag, so compatible/suggested objects now get the secondary-tinted highlighted style instead of being indistinguishable from a real hover.

Verified in the running puzzle-3d-react-dev browser preview against the Nakagin Capsule Tower fixture (180 objects): mesh fill now shows the theme --panel color with visible dark edge outlines on every capsule module (previously flat and edgeless); hover shows the interactive-hover fill with emphasized edges; selection shows the primary-red tint plus a halo outline; toggling document.documentElement's dark class now correctly repaints every mesh to the dark-mode --panel/--border tones (confirmed the cache-bust fix). framework/renderer/react test suite: 105/106 pass (added a resolveMeshStyle priority-order test); the one failure is in os-shell.tsx, pre-existing and unrelated to this change (dirty from a concurrent session at ticket start). cargo check -p puzzle-plugin passed clean (only pre-existing unrelated warnings).
